reviews.comment: Bought these to use for some work stations and eventually moved the hardware to a pc using an atx board and 8th gen i5. Perfectly compatible.
reviews.author: Trevor

reviews.title: Works as advertised. Easy to install. Slightly overpriced.
reviews.comment: I was somewhat hesitant buying OEM memory modules on Amazon since I had seen videos on YouTube about buyers getting scammed and things like that. However, I was pleasantly surprised by my purchase. I had no issues installing the RAM, the RAM runs at its advertised speed (2667mhz), and it seems to work perfectly. Though, it is a bit overpriced for what it is. On a side note, this provides a HUGE performance boost for my PC since I went from 1 stick of 8GB running in single channel to 2 sticks of 8GB (16GB total) running in dual channel! If your motherboard supports it, I recommend going for a faster memory speed (3200mhz). If it cannot, or if you are not sure, then this will work perfectly. It was an exact match for the stick my pre-built PC already had.
reviews.author: Keith M.
